Aiyagari1994.M09B1.finiteCap_equilibrium:
Aiyagari1994.M09B1.finiteCap_equilibrium_exists_core (p : Aiyagari1994.ProductionData)
  (hp : Aiyagari1994.ProductionRegularity p) (m : Aiyagari1994.HouseholdPrimitives)
  (hsmooth : Aiyagari1994.UtilitySmooth m.utility) (hcurvature : Aiyagari1994.UtilityCurvature m.utility)
  (hnd : Aiyagari1994.IncomeNondegenerate m.income) (hmean : Aiyagari1994.LaborMeanOne m.income) (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
  ∃ (e : Aiyagari1994.StationaryEquilibrium p hp),
    e.household.beta = m.beta ∧
      e.household.utility = m.utility ∧
        e.household.income = m.income ∧
          e.originalPrices.debtLimit =
              Aiyagari1994.effectiveLimit b m.income.lower (Aiyagari1994.firmWage p hp e.rate) ↑e.rate ∧
            -p.depreciation < ↑e.rate ∧ ↑e.rate < 1 / m.beta - 1
